title: Multi-Language Graph
description: Extend the project knowledge graph beyond JS/TS. Add import parsers for Python (import, from x import), Go (import blocks), Rust (use declarations), and Java (import statements). All non-JS projects will get fully resolved dependency graphs.

title: Visual Graph Export
description: Export the project knowledge graph as a Mermaid diagram embedded directly inside TOKENCAP_GRAPH.md. Renders as a visual dependency map in GitHub, VS Code, and any Markdown viewer that supports Mermaid.

title: Incremental Snapshots
description: Only re-process changed files on subsequent runs instead of scanning the full project every time. Dramatically reduces generation time for large codebases.
source: Architecture analysis — current full-scan approach in collectFiles()

title: Graph Cycle Detection
description: Detect circular import dependencies in the project graph and surface them as warnings in TOKENCAP_GRAPH.md.
source: Architecture analysis — buildGraph.js edge model supports cycle detection
